thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes
next week for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hi Harper,

I help Bob with his calendar. He would like to find 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Any of these work on his side:

- Mon, Oct 12, 10:45am to 11:15am ET
- Mon, Oct 12, 4:15pm to 4:45pm ET
- Tue, Oct 13, 2:15pm to 2:45pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc. (The ledger row in the capture carries no rationale; this line stands in.)
